about_the_game:
Demo consists of only 3 dialogues and characters. Full version will consist of many more characters, dialogues, choices and consequences.

Take role as Dr. Smith, psychotherapist. Game consists of real people video recordings. Talk with them, treat, learn about psychology. Your choices have consequences, at the end of the game, after waiting 3 minutes after all dialogues you will see summary.

Game features:
  • Real people video recordings
  • Your choices matter - treatment and diagnosis has impact on summary at the end
  • You always have choice about dialogue - there is always more than one option to choose in dialogue
  • No computer animations, but real people emotions, because of real recordings
  • You have book to read and learn about mental health diagnoses like personality disorders
  • You have second book to diagnose and treat patients
  • Doctor says random things about his life during the day
Thanks for videos to:
Candice Donovan
mcnichoj
